author.name: Data Dave
author.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

challenge.name: The Inconsistent Checks
challenge.description: #data_dave# insists on keeping the quality checks manually done to control costs. #reliability_ruth# argues for full automation to ensure consistent results.

output.content: Hi team, I've been thinking about the automation discussions. I know {reliability_ruth} wants everything automated for consistency. I get that, but I think we can find a middle ground. If we use open source tools for automation, we can keep costs down. I would be okay with some manual processes if it means we don't have to invest in expensive proprietary solutions. Lets talk about this in the next meeting. Thanks, {data_dave}.
output.reclassify_reason: Data Dave is willing to accept some manual processes to avoid the cost of proprietary solutions.
